title: Cutover probe bounded redacted verdict acceptance
delivery: protected tests only; deliberately RED, do not open or merge a standalone failing PR
dependencies: Python standard library only; main(fetch_fn=...) doubles and offline urllib opener double; socket creation prohibited

observed_baseline.classification: behavioral RED, not a compile/cache/infrastructure refusal
observed_baseline.existing_qa_cutover_suite: 98/98 offline tests pass; the one existing loopback HTTP-server test is explicitly excluded, not claimed passing

machine_contract.stdout: Exactly one JSON object with verdict, next_action, checks; stderr empty for ordinary probe verdicts
machine_contract.verdict: PASS or FAIL; exit 0 or 1 respectively
machine_contract.checks: Nonempty array; unique id, verdict, code, next_action on every check
machine_contract.origin_refusal_id: Builder chooses a stable check ID; it need not fabricate remote check results before origin admission
machine_contract.codes: Builder chooses bounded lowercase fixed-vocabulary codes; repeated equivalent failures with different secret sentinels must retain the same IDs/codes/next actions
machine_contract.next_action: Nonempty string at report and check level, at most 256 characters, no untrusted reflection
machine_contract.output_bound: At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes total stdout plus stderr for tested inputs
machine_contract.failure_attestation: Failed JSON verdict must not claim result=pass; failed runs must neither create nor overwrite --evidence
machine_contract.success_attestation: Existing separate --evidence file remains result=pass with five source-cited checks; JSON output is not that file

coverage: Reject credential-bearing wrong-scheme, bad-port and malformed-bracket combinations before fetching; no raw or truncated credential reflection
Reject hostless and unusable-port origins; preserve HTTP, IPv6, explicit usable ports and trailing-slash normalization
Treat in-cap depth-2000 JSON on both routes and malformed remote structures as failed checks without escaping exceptions
Validate build_revision/build_id against the shared supported canonical SHA/run-attempt shapes or exact unknown/unknown pair, not arbitrary strings
Redact malformed build fields, unknown job names, arbitrary error classes and top-level fence error/reason fields, including controls and token-shaped input
Bound output with 400 unknown jobs; retain unknown-job ungraded semantics instead of inventing cadence rules
Ignore arbitrary extra fields in successful output and evidence; retain seven supported error classes and null
Preserve clean ready, truthful parked, --expect-ready, duplicate-key refusal, body cap, GET-only transport and no redirects
Discoverable machine output, repeated stable codes, JSON ready/parked/malformed round trips and success-only evidence
builder_handoff: Consume the immutable published acceptance head; keep the protected file byte-identical. Acceptance corrections return to the test author.
Implement only the paired probe behavior; update docs/runbook.md:61-70 (the short probe guide) and unprotected offline tests in the combined passing PR.

Existing unprotected fixtures use noncanonical r/b and abc123/42 identities and one expects raw unknown-job names. Update those fixtures/expectations to supported identities and redacted counts without weakening parked, cadence or success-attestation policy.
Keep body cap, timeout, duplicate-key rejection, no redirects, GET-only and readiness policy; no live invocation, new credential source, endpoint, production-affecting flag or deployment.
No product code or guide changes were made by the test author. Full required CI, independent review and controller auto-merge belong to the Builder's combined passing PR.
